costume.name: Cosmic Cowboy
costume.description: Silver western wear with fringe, pointed boots, and a blue neckerchief.
costume.alt: A composition of the sourced cowboy pieces on pale grey: cowboy hat, a detail of the fringe jacket, trousers, western boots and blue neckerchief.

pieces.name: Silver cowboy hat
pieces.styleNotes: A shiny metallic silver cowboy hat with a wide curved brim brings a space-age shimmer to a classic western crown. Holographic or sequin finishes add to the cosmic effect.
queries: handmade silver metallic cowboy hat Etsy
vintage style silver sequin cowboy hat western wear
holographic silver space cowboy hat handmade

matches.reason: Silver metallic cowboy hat; optional crystal star. Made to order in Costa Mesa. S/M fits 20–22.5 inches; L/XL fits 23–24.5 inches. Feed confirms both silver variants in stock at $140; do not use the gold variants.
Silver sequins and white LED brim. Adult costume accessory; dimensions 15 x 9.5 x 5 inches. LEDs can remain off. Page states 14,430 in stock; single-unit price $9.99.
Metallic silver adult cowboy hat with rhinestone trim. Current merchant variant feed is $42.99, lower than the older search-index price of $44.99. One adult size.

pieces.name: Fringed western jacket
pieces.styleNotes: A thrifted 70s-style western jacket in silver lamé, metallic leather or sequins, with long swinging fringe across the chest and sleeves. The classic yoke silhouette keeps it western while the shine makes it otherworldly.
queries: vintage silver metallic fringe western jacket
handmade sequin fringe cowboy jacket Etsy
vintage 70s western fringe jacket silver lamé

matches.reason: Silver zip-front moto jacket with chest fringe, notched lapels, zip pockets and snaps. Current feed confirms XS, Small, Medium, Large and XL at $71. Photo review confirms a metallic silver jacket under warm shop lighting; cool blue reflections show on sleeves. Gallery has two views of this same silver-only product; all variants are sizes, not colors. Existing reviewed product extraction p-2776c6bc82.jpg is visually clearer.
Adult KBW silver tinsel fringe costume jacket. This listing offers L/XL only; confirm body measurements. Allover tinsel is a disco interpretation, not a tailored western yoke.

Silver allover tinsel fringe; round neck, button placket and short straight cut. 100% polyester. S/M/L variants are in stock at $102, final sale. More expensive here describes price only, not proven quality.

pieces.name: Silver trousers
pieces.styleNotes: Shiny silver metallic trousers with a slight flare or bootcut that sits well over pointed boots. Look for foil-coated denim, lamé or disco-era fabric.
queries: handmade silver lamé flare trousers Etsy
silver foil coated western bootcut jeans

matches.reason: USA-made high-shine silver-black foil-coated denim bell bottoms. Darker than pure silver. Sizes 3/5/7/9/11/13/15 at 30, 32 and 34-inch inseams all confirm available at $120 in current feed.

Underwraps high-waisted silver metallic stretch bell bottoms with elastic waistband. Correct silver photo visually reviewed against all three gallery colorways. Current feed confirms Silver XS and Silver S/M in stock at $24.99; L/XL is sold out. Replaces pale white-looking Bellissima pants after image QA.
Fluid silver satin wide-leg pants with front pleats, button and zip fly. 100% polyester. S/M/L/XL in stock at $39. Satin sheen rather than high-shine foil; wide leg fits over boots.

pieces.name: Pointed western boots
pieces.styleNotes: Pointed-toe leather cowboy boots with a stacked heel in white, silver or black to anchor the outfit. Vintage boots with tooling or stitched shafts add authentic western character.
queries: vintage pointed toe leather western boots
vintage women's or men's snip toe cowboy boots secondhand

matches.reason: Silver leather western boot with star inlays, snip toe, 9-inch shaft and 3-inch heel. Current feed confirms every offered size 6–11 (including half sizes through 9.5) in medium width at $79.99.
Silver rhinestone western ankle boots with pointed toe and block heel. Current feed confirms US 6, 6.5 and 8.5 in stock at $34.99. Limited size coverage; not suitable for other sizes.

Dingo Silver Dollar DI570 silver leather western boot with rhinestones, snip toe, 12-inch shaft, 2.5-inch heel. Current feed confirms medium-width sizes 7/7.5/8/9/9.5/10 at $239.99. Search-rendered HTML was six months old and contradicted current inventory; use current .js feed.

pieces.name: Bright blue neckerchief
pieces.styleNotes: A vivid cobalt or electric blue cotton or silk bandana knotted at the neck gives a pop of colour against the silver. Choose a plain or lightly patterned vintage-style square.
queries: vintage bright blue silk western neckerchief
handmade cobalt blue cotton bandana neck scarf Etsy
electric blue western wild rag scarf
